apply_strain_to_atoms: apply a strain matrix to an ASE Atoms object to deform its unit cell and atomic positions
get_displacement_and_cell: prepare a displacement tensor and original cell from AtomicData for gradient-based stress computation
compute_stress_from_cell_displacement: compute stress and forces from energy gradients with respect to a symmetric strain displacement tensor
test_stress_old_vs_new_single_system: test that old and new stress implementations produce identical results for a single atomic system
test_stress_old_vs_new_batch_prediction: test that old and new stress implementations produce identical results for batched atomic structures
